role: CI gate: every String(localized:) / NSLocalizedString( call in Emuqu/Sources must contain a `bundle:` argument within its parentheses.
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; cd to repo root. SOURCE_ROOT=$1 or Emuqu/Sources (missing -> 2). Calls find_offenders "$SOURCE_ROOT" inside "$(…)" (the Python is in that function, not a here-document inside the substitution, so macOS bash 3.2 parses it); the Python masks string literals, finds String(localized:/NSLocalizedString( calls, skips lines starting //, paren-matches the call and requires `bundle:` inside and no `bundle: .main` / `bundle: Bundle.main`. Offenders -> exit 1. Else counts lookups with grep and prints clean. Watch target deliberately excluded. Wired: gates.yml, ci.yml, Makefile.

flags.text: README says every lookup must name LanguageManager.appBundle; the gate accepts any `bundle:` argument (e.g. bundle: .main).

units.does: Runs the embedded Python over the Swift files under the given source root and prints one line per String(localized:)/NSLocalizedString( call that has no bundle: argument or names Bundle.main. Its exit status is the Python's.
units.entry: Called once from the script's top level inside offenders="$(…)".
